_comment: Verified credits from English Wikipedia infoboxes (retrieved 2026-08-22). Synopses are original BRYME copy. Do not treat as live streaming listings.

titles.title: Wicked
titles.description: Long before Dorothy, two witches share a school, a friendship, and a falling-out that Oz will retell as a fairy tale. Jon M. Chu’s film is the first half of the stage musical: Elphaba and Glinda, before the world decides who is wicked.

titles.title: Wicked: For Good
titles.description: The second half of the Wicked story. Elphaba is in exile, Glinda is the public face of Oz, and the arrival everyone already knows is almost here. A sequel only if you already know how the first film ends.

titles.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
titles.description: Peter Parker is back from Germany with a high-tech suit and a crush on being an Avenger. Homecoming keeps him in Queens: homework, a homecoming dance, and a salvage dealer who will not stay small. The MCU’s first solo Spider-Man film.

titles.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
titles.description: A school trip across Europe is supposed to be a break after the snap. Instead Peter meets a man who can make the sky lie, and Nick Fury will not take no for an answer. The second Holland solo film, set after Endgame.

titles.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
titles.director: Joaquim Dos Santos; Kemp Powers; Justin K. Thompson
titles.description: Miles Morales is a year older and still the only Spider-Man his Brooklyn knows. Then the Spider-Society arrives with rules about which lives you are allowed to save. A sequel to Into the Spider-Verse, not a recap.

titles.title: Animal
titles.description: A son who cannot sit still in his father’s shadow answers a hit with a war. Sandeep Reddy Vanga’s film is long, bloody, and built around Ranbir Kapoor as a man who calls obsession love. Not a part-one teaser — this is the whole argument.

titles.title: Article 370
titles.description: A Delhi-based agent is sent into Kashmir around the 2019 constitutional change that ended the state’s special status. The film follows the operation, not a civics lecture. Yami Gautam Dhar leads.

titles.title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
titles.description: Pushpa Raj is no longer climbing. The sequel to The Rise puts him in a fight with the state, a rival syndicate, and a cop who will not drop the file. Allu Arjun returns; so does Fahadh Faasil.

titles.title: Kalki 2898-AD
titles.description: Kasi in the year 2898 is a desert city waiting for a prophecy. Nag Ashwin folds the Mahabharata into a future-war film with Prabhas, Deepika Padukone, Amitabh Bachchan and Kamal Haasan. Big-scale Indian sci-fi, not a Hollywood remake.

titles.title: Stree 2
titles.description: Chanderi has a new night problem, and the same group of friends who survived the first Stree are not ready. Amar Kaushik keeps the horror-comedy mix: a spirit, a town rumour, and Rajkummar Rao trying to be brave.

titles.title: KPop Demon Hunters
titles.description: A K-pop girl group hunts demons between choreography and comeback stages. Sony Pictures Animation’s 2025 film is a musical action cartoon, not a concert film. The billed voices include Arden Cho and Ahn Hyo-seop.

titles.title: Fifty Shades of Grey
titles.description: A literature student interviews a Seattle billionaire and stays. Sam Taylor-Johnson’s film is the first of the E. L. James adaptations: Dakota Johnson and Jamie Dornan, a contract, and a relationship that is not a fairy tale.

titles.title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle
titles.description: The Corps is pulled into Muzan’s fortress of shifting rooms. Haruo Sotozaki’s theatrical continuation of Demon Slayer is a movie, not a recap episode. Tanjiro, Nezuko and the Hashira go in knowing the castle does not want them out.

titles.title: Zootopia 2
titles.description: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde are back on a case that the city would rather file away. Disney Animation’s sequel keeps the buddy-cop shape of the 2016 film and adds a reptile the first movie barely showed.

titles.title: Predator: Badlands
titles.description: Dan Trachtenberg’s next Predator film follows a young Yautja on a hunt that does not go to plan. Elle Fanning is the human the story will not drop. A franchise entry, not a remake of the 1987 film.

titles.title: The Housemaid
titles.description: A woman takes a live-in job with a wealthy couple and finds the house has rules that are not in the contract. Paul Feig’s 2025 thriller is an adaptation of Freida McFadden’s novel — not the 2010 Korean film of the same name.

titles.title: War of the Worlds
titles.description: A 2025 invasion story told largely through screens. Ice Cube plays a DHS analyst watching the attack in real time. This is not Spielberg’s 2005 film and not a claim that the two share a story.

titles.title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
titles.description: The third Avatar film. Jake and Neytiri take the family into fire-clan country after the way of water. James Cameron is still in the chair; Sam Worthington and Zoe Saldaña return.

titles.title: Backrooms
titles.description: A Kane Parsons feature built from the internet’s yellow-room creepypasta. Chiwetel Ejiofor and Renate Reinsve are the billed leads. Not a found-footage YouTube compilation.

titles.title: Bad Newz
titles.description: A messy love triangle sold as a comedy. Vicky Kaushal, Triptii Dimri and Ammy Virk. Anand Tiwari’s 2024 Hindi film, not a news satire.

titles.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3
titles.description: Kartik Aaryan walks into another haunted palace; Vidya Balan and Madhuri Dixit are already inside the joke. Anees Bazmee’s third Bhool Bhulaiyaa, still a horror-comedy.

titles.title: Chainsaw Man: Reze
titles.description: The Reze Arc, as a movie. Tatsuya Yoshihara directs; Kikunosuke Toya returns as Denji. A theatrical Chainsaw Man chapter, not a recap of the TV season.

titles.title: Citizen Vigilante
titles.description: Uwe Boll’s late-period action film with Armie Hammer. A man takes the law personally. BRYME lists the billed names and the trailer — not a review of Boll’s catalogue.

titles.title: Camp Rock 3
titles.description: Disney’s camp musical comes back with a new set of kids. Liamani, Malachi Barton and Lumi Pollack are the billed names. A sequel, not a reunion of the first two films’ whole cast.

titles.title: Freakier Friday
titles.description: Lindsay Lohan is back in the body-swap comedy, this time with a next generation in the mix. Nisha Ganatra directs. A sequel to Freaky Friday, not a remake of the 2003 film.

titles.title: Devara: Part 1
titles.description: N. T. Rama Rao Jr. in a coastal-action saga from Koratala Siva. Saif Ali Khan and Janhvi Kapoor are billed opposite him. Part 1 of a two-film story.

titles.title: Greenland 2
titles.description: The family that survived the comet now has to move. Gerard Butler returns in Ric Roman Waugh’s sequel to Greenland. A disaster chase, not a documentary.

titles.title: Disclosure Day
titles.description: Steven Spielberg’s UFO film. Emily Blunt and Josh O’Connor are the billed leads. A first-contact story from a director who has done this neighbourhood before.

titles.title: Hoppers
titles.description: Pixar-adjacent creature comedy from Daniel Chong. Piper Curda, Bobby Moynihan and Jon Hamm are the billed voices. Animals with jobs; not a Zootopia clone by default.

titles.title: Dhurandhar
titles.description: Aditya Dhar’s spy-action film with Ranveer Singh. Akshaye Khanna and Arjun Rampal are billed in the opposition. A Hindi espionage picture, not a biopic claim.

titles.title: Colony
titles.description: Yeon Sang-ho’s sci-fi with Jun Ji-hyun, Koo Kyo-hwan and Ji Chang-wook. A future colony under pressure. From the director of Train to Busan, not a sequel to that film.

titles.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
titles.description: The sixth Insidious film. Jacob Chase directs; Amelia Eve, Brandon Perea and Maisie Richardson-Sellers lead, with Lin Shaye back. A 2026 continuation, not a remake of the 2010 original.

titles.title: Moana
titles.description: Disney’s live-action Moana. Thomas Kail directs; the billed cast includes Rena Owen, John Tui and Frankie Adams. A new telling of the 2016 animation, not a shot-for-shot copy claim.

titles.title: Mutiny
titles.description: Jean-François Richet’s shipboard thriller. Annabelle Wallis, Roland Møller and Adrian Lester are billed. A mutiny story, not a franchise reboot.

titles.title: Munjya
titles.description: A Konkan wedding, a family curse, and a spirit who will not stay in the tree. Aditya Sarpotdar’s horror-comedy with Abhay Verma and Sharvari. Hindi, 2024.

titles.title: Minions & Monsters
titles.description: Pierre Coffin’s next Minions outing. Trey Parker, Allison Janney and Christoph Waltz are among the billed voices. Illumination slapstick, not a Despicable Me recap.

titles.title: Obsession
titles.description: Curry Barker’s obsession thriller. Michael Johnston and Inde Navarrette are billed. A small-cast spiral, not a remake of the 1976 De Palma film.

titles.title: Supergirl
titles.description: Milly Alcock as Kara in James Gunn’s DCU. Craig Gillespie directs; Matthias Schoenaerts is billed opposite her. A new Supergirl, not a continuation of the CW show.

titles.title: Project Hail Mary
titles.description: Phil Lord and Christopher Miller adapt Andy Weir. A lone scientist and a problem that will not wait. Sandra Hüller is among the billed names. Not a The Martian sequel.

titles.title: SWAPPED
titles.description: Nathan Greno’s body-swap comedy. Michael B. Jordan, Juno Temple and Tracy Morgan are billed. A high-concept switch, not a Freaky Friday remake.

titles.title: Scream 7
titles.description: Ghostface again. Neve Campbell returns; Kevin Williamson is billed as director. Isabel May and Jasmin Savoy Brown join. A new Scream, not a reboot of the 1996 film from zero.

titles.title: Singham Again
titles.description: Rohit Shetty’s cop-universe pile-up. Kareena Kapoor Khan, Arjun Kapoor and Jackie Shroff are billed alongside the Singham brand. A masala ensemble, not a single-hero origin.

titles.title: Scary Movie
titles.description: The Wayans-era names come back: Anna Faris, Regina Hall, Marlon Wayans. Michael Tiddes directs. A new Scary Movie, not a recut of the 2000 film.

titles.title: Shelter
titles.description: Ric Roman Waugh’s survival picture. Naomi Ackie and Daniel Mays are billed. A family under a sky that has gone wrong. Not a remake of the 2010 Julianne Moore Shelter.

titles.title: Vikram
titles.description: Lokesh Kanagaraj’s Tamil action film. Kamal Haasan’s title role sits opposite Vijay Sethupathi and Fahadh Faasil. A 2022 hit, not a remake of the 1986 Vikram.

titles.title: The Gorge
titles.description: Two snipers watch a valley they are not allowed to explain. Scott Derrickson directs Miles Teller and Anya Taylor-Joy. A 2025 thriller, not a war documentary.

titles.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
titles.description: Aaron Horvath and Michael Jelenic send Mario off-world. Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Charlie Day are billed again. A sequel to The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

titles.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
titles.description: Miranda Priestly is not done. David Frankel returns with Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway and Emily Blunt. A sequel to the 2006 fashion-desk film.

titles.title: The Devil's Mouth
titles.description: Jeff Wadlow’s young-adult horror. Kathryn Newton, Lana Condor and Gavin Casalegno are billed. A town with a hole it should have left closed.

titles.title: The Shadow's Edge
titles.description: Jackie Chan in a contemporary action film from Larry Yang. Zhang Zifeng and Tony Leung Ka-fai are billed. A 2025 crime-action picture, not a period kung-fu remake.

titles.title: Yodha
titles.description: Siddharth Malhotra in an airborne action film. Raashii Khanna and Disha Patani are billed. A 2024 Hindi thriller set around a hijack, not a mythological epic.

titles.title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
titles.description: Aang is grown and the war is over, until an old power threatens the peace he already paid for. Lauren Montgomery directs the Avatar Studios feature; Eric Nam voices Aang, with Dave Bautista, Jessica Matten, Román Zaragoza and Steven Yeun billed. A new animated film, not a recut of the Nickelodeon series.

titles.title: GOAT
titles.description: A young goat wants to be the greatest at roarball. Tyree Dillihay’s Sony Pictures Animation film stars Caleb McLaughlin, with Gabrielle Union and Aaron Pierre billed. This is the 2026 American cartoon — not Vijay’s 2024 Tamil film The Greatest of All Time.

titles.title: Jackass: Best and Last
titles.description: Jeff Tremaine’s fifth and billed-final Jackass film. Old stunts, new stunts, and the same crew talking over the wreckage. Johnny Knoxville, Steve-O and Chris Pontius are billed. Not a recut of Jackass Forever.

titles.title: Kraken
titles.description: A marine biologist is sent to a Norwegian salmon farm after the fish and the gear start dying wrong. Pål Øie directs; Sara Khorami leads. A 2026 Norwegian monster film, not a Hollywood kraken franchise.

titles.title: The Invite
titles.description: A marriage on thin ice invites the neighbours upstairs. Olivia Wilde directs and stars with Seth Rogen, Edward Norton and Penélope Cruz. An English-language take on Cesc Gay’s The People Upstairs — not a horror film about a cursed RSVP.

titles.title: The Last House
titles.description: A family is sealed inside their house by a threat they cannot see yet. Louis Leterrier directs Greta Lee and Wagner Moura. A 2026 Netflix thriller — not The Last House on the Left.

titles.title: Coraline
titles.description: Henry Selick’s stop-motion of Neil Gaiman’s book. Dakota Fanning voices a girl who finds a better mother behind a small door. Teri Hatcher is billed. 2009, not the later stage musical.

titles.title: Awarapan
titles.description: Mohit Suri’s 2007 Hindi noir. Emraan Hashmi plays a man who does other people’s violence until it comes home. Shriya Saran is billed opposite him.

titles.title: Deep Water
titles.description: Adrian Lyne’s erotic thriller. Ben Affleck and Ana de Armas as a marriage that has already made a dangerous deal. A 2022 film, not a diving documentary.

titles.title: Captain America: Brave New World
titles.description: Anthony Mackie picks up the shield. Julius Onah directs the MCU’s next Captain America film. Danny Ramirez and Shira Haas are billed. Not a recut of The Winter Soldier.

titles.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
titles.description: Nia DaCosta’s follow-up to 28 Years Later. Ralph Fiennes and Jack O’Connell are billed in a country that never really ended the rage. A sequel, not a remake of 28 Days Later.

titles.title: Enola Holmes 3
titles.description: Philip Barantini’s third Enola case. Louis Partridge returns as Tewkesbury. A Netflix mystery sequel, not a reboot of the Guy Ritchie Sherlock films.

titles.title: Cocktail 2
titles.description: Homi Adajania returns to the Cocktail title with Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon and Rashmika Mandanna. A new triangle, not a shot-for-shot of the 2012 film.

titles.title: Fifty Shades Freed
titles.description: James Foley’s third Fifty Shades film. Dakota Johnson and Jamie Dornan close the contract. 2018 — the last of the trilogy, not a remake of the first.

titles.title: Mission: Impossible – The Final Reckoning
titles.description: Christopher McQuarrie’s next Ethan Hunt film. Tom Cruise returns; Hayley Atwell, Ving Rhames and Simon Pegg are billed. The 2025 follow-up to Dead Reckoning.

titles.title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
titles.description: Jon Favreau takes the Disney+ pair to theatres. Pedro Pascal is billed; Jeremy Allen White joins. A Star Wars film, not a recut of the TV series.

titles.title: Masters of the Universe
titles.description: Travis Knight’s live-action He-Man. Nicholas Galitzine, Camila Mendes and Alison Brie are billed. A 2026 feature, not the 1987 Dolph Lundgren film.

titles.title: My Fault
titles.description: Nicole Wallace and Gabriel Guevara in the first Culpa mía film. A Spanish-language romance that became a streaming hit. Not a Hollywood remake.

titles.title: The Drama
titles.description: Kristoffer Borgli’s film with Zendaya and Robert Pattinson. A relationship story sold as The Drama. 2026, not a making-of documentary.

titles.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
titles.description: Lee Cronin starts a new Mummy. Jack Reynor, Laia Costa and May Calamawy are billed. A 2026 horror film, not the 1999 Brendan Fraser adventure or the 2017 Cruise film.

titles.title: Our Fault
titles.description: The Culpa mía follow-up with Nicole Wallace and Gabriel Guevara again. A sequel, not a separate franchise.

titles.title: Welcome to the Jungle
titles.description: Rob Meltzer’s 2013 action-comedy. Jean-Claude Van Damme, Adam Brody and Megan Boone are billed. Not The Rock’s Jumanji movie.

titles.title: In the Grey
titles.description: Guy Ritchie’s spy picture. Henry Cavill and Jake Gyllenhaal are billed, with Eiza González. A contemporary thriller, not a period war film.

titles.title: The Death of Robin Hood
titles.description: Michael Sarnoski’s take on the end of the outlaw. Jodie Comer, Bill Skarsgård and Murray Bartlett are billed. Not a recut of the 1991 Costner film.

titles.title: The Sheep Detectives
titles.description: Kyle Balda’s comedy. Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun and Nicholas Galitzine are billed. A mystery with livestock, not a nature documentary.

titles.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
titles.description: Reinaldo Marcus Green’s Punisher film. Deborah Ann Woll and Jason R. Moore are billed from the TV series. A Marvel crime picture, not a recut of the 2004 Thomas Jane film.

titles.title: Hungry
titles.description: James Nunn’s horror. Madison Davenport and Joaquim de Almeida are billed. A 2026 creature/appetite film, not a food documentary.
